in_arabic.name: ريحانة
in_arabic.meaning: ريحانة تعني زهرة أو نبتة طيبة الرائحة في اللغة العربية
in_arabic.long_meaning: اسم ريحانة مشتق من الفعل ريحان والذي يعني النبتة الطيبة الرائحة، ورد ذكره في القرآن الكريم كرمز للخير والرزق، ويعتبر من الأسماء المحببة في الثقافة الإسلامية

in_urdu.name: ریحانہ
in_urdu.meaning: ریحانہ کا مطلب ہے خوشبو دار پودا یا زهرہ
in_urdu.long_meaning: ریحانہ نام عربی زبان کی ایک معروف اصطلاح ہے جو خوشبو دار پودوں یا زہروں کو کہا جاتا ہے، اسلامی تقویم میں اس کا ذکر اچھے اور وافر رزق کی علامت کے طور پر کیا گیا ہے

in_hindi.name: रिहाना
in_hindi.meaning: रिहाना का अर्थ है सुगंधित पौधा या फूल
in_hindi.long_meaning: रिहाना नाम की उत्पत्ति अरबी भाषा से हुई है, जिसका अर्थ है सुगंधित पौधा या फूल, यह नाम इस्लामी संस्कृति में बहुत पसंद किया जाता है और इसे अच्छे और समृद्धि के प्रतीक के रूप में देखा जाता है

in_pashto.name: ریحانہ
in_pashto.meaning: ریحانہ د خوشبو لرونکی ګل یا نبات معنی
in_pashto.long_meaning: د ريحانہ نوم په عربي ژبه کې د خوشبو لرونکی ګل یا نبات په معنا دی، دا نوم د اسلامي کلتور په منځ کې د منلو وړ دی او د نیکمرغۍ او کثرت د نښې په توګه ګڼل کیږي

in_english.name: Rihanah
in_english.meaning: Rihanah means fragrant plant or flower in English
in_english.long_meaning: Rihanah is derived from the Arabic root 'r-ḥ-n' which signifies fragrant plants or flowers, mentioned in the Quran as a symbol of good and abundance, it holds spiritual significance and positive connotations in Islamic tradition and culture

data.cultural_impact: The name Rihanah has its roots in the Arabic language, signifying a rare and exotic scent, akin to a beautiful and precious flower. It is a name that evokes the idea of beauty and elegance, especially within Islamic and Arabic cultures. Given its association with fragrance and beauty, Rihanah can be a popular choice for parents looking for a name that exudes charm and grace. Moreover, Rihanah shares a name with a significant female figure in Islamic history, Rehana bint Al-Hakam, a respected Sufi saint and a devotee of Prophet Muhammad (PBUH). Thus, Rihanah can also represent the embodiment of religious virtues as well as physical beauty.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name Rihanah signifies the inner sweetness and fragrance of one's soul. It serves as a reminder that just as a beautiful flower blooms and exudes a pleasant fragrance, our souls can also emit positive energy that uplifts and inspires those around us. Additionally, the Islamic tradition of 'Tasbeeh' or the practice of continuously repeating 'Subhanallah' (Glory be to Allah) , serves as a way to purify one's soul and infuse it with the fragrance of Allah's love and presence. In this context, the name Rihanah can be seen as a reminder to cultivate a beautiful, pure, and fragrant soul through constant spiritual practices and devotion to Allah. Ultimately, the name Rihanah reflects the idea that our inner beauty and spiritual grace are intimately connected and can positively impact ourselves and those around us.
